voxbox.desc: You can press <toggle_inv> to open your inventory.

Your primary will be placed in your Sling/Back. Your sidearm will be placed in your Holster. And your melee weapon will be placed in your scabbard. You can find them in the first, second and third spots in the toolbar.
Use your axe to chop these planks of wood with <left mouse button> and <right mouse button>
Thank you. We now have some more wood for a campfire!
Now, chop this target dummy.
Now, switch to your pistol and shoot those dummies untill you're out of ammo. You can press <reload> to reload, or hold <reload> to choose which magazine to load.
Now, reload your N4 and send those dummy to hell!

voxbox.desc: You might find different guns that share the same mag as your current gun.
In the inventory screen, right click a gun and unload its mag. Then, right click the mag to unload its bullets.

You can load bullets into a mag by dragging the bullets item and hovering it over the appropriate magazine. You can reload a mag into a gun with the same drag-and-hover procedure. You can hold <drop_item> on the items you nolonger need to discard them.
You can also switch between the primary weapons by pressing <1> again.

Sometimes you want to take out enemy at long distances. The TCR-308 you just found will do that nicely. You can switch to semi-automatic with <select_fire> and aim down sights with <RightClick> \n You can also throw a grenade with <throw_grenade>

voxbox.desc: The last thing you need to know is how to refuel a vehicle and drive. Fuelcans cannot be placed in your inventory like other items. You will have to carry or place in your vehicle/trunk to take them with you.

You can transfer fuel between gas cans by holding one gas can above another and holding <Interact>. Broken gas cans will leak fuel until they are empty. Make sure you don't rely on them. Let's refuel this vehicle. And bring the gas can with you.

group.name: drive cost fuel, siphon fuel, doors

voxbox.desc: Driving will also cost you fuel. Mind you, the vehicle will stop when it runs out of fuel.
Lets check out this hummer at the right side.
The Hummer has no fuel. Luckily, you can siphon fuel from the jeep into the fuel can. While seated in the jeep, hold <siphon_fuel> to siphon fuel into the fuel can.
Also, equip the RPG, you will see whats next. Let's drive.
